arxiv-2302-12347.title: MetaLDC: Meta Learning of Low-Dimensional Computing Classifiers for Fast On-Device Adaption
arxiv-2302-12347.creator: Yejia Liu, Shijin Duan, Xiaolin Xu, Shaolei Ren
arxiv-2302-12347.description: Abstract . Fast model updates for unseen tasks on intelligent edge devices are crucial but also challenging due to the limited computational power. In this paper, we propose MetaLDC, which meta-trains brain-inspired ultra-efficient low-dimensional computing classifiers to enable fast adaptation on tiny devices with minimal computational costs.

arxiv-2502-17737.title: Domination and multistate systems
arxiv-2502-17737.creator: Arne Bang Huseby
arxiv-2502-17737.description: Abstract Domination theory has been studied extensively in the context of binary monotone systems, where the structure function is a sum of products of the component state variables, and with coefficients given by the signed domination function. Using e.g., matroid theory, many useful properties of the signed domination function has been derived.

arxiv-2506-06924.creator: Andrew Elvey Price \addressmark 1, Wenjie Fang \addressmark 2, Baptiste Louf \addressmark 3, Michael Wallner \addressmark 4
arxiv-2506-06924.description: Abstract We obtain bivariate asymptotics for the number of (unicellular) combinatorial maps (a model of discrete surfaces) as both the size and the genus grow. pmc-11368372.creator: Saili S. Pradhan, Jagdish A. Cacodcar, Dhanya Jose, Nikhil S. Akarkar
pmc-11368372.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Context:Access to safe and nutritious food is key to promoting good health. An estimated 600 million fall ill after eating contaminated food, for which food handlers may constitute a common source of contamination. In addition to unhealthy food handlers, disease carriers handling the food play an equally important role in transmitting these diseases and pose a significant threat to public health.

pmc-11611591.title: Leaf nutrient traits exhibit greater environmental plasticity compared to resource utilization traits along an elevational gradient
pmc-11611591.creator: Xing Zhang, Jie Duan, Yuhui Ji, Weiguo Liu, Jie Gao
pmc-11611591.description: Studying key leaf functional traits is crucial for understanding plant resource utilization strategies and growth. To explore the patterns and driving factors of key leaf functional traits in forests along elevational gradients under global change, we collected survey data from 697 forests across China from 2008 to 2020.

pmc-11622148.title: Short Root Anomaly and Transverse Hemimelia: A Rare Case Presentation
pmc-11622148.creator: Emmanuel Mazinis, Vasilios Thomaidis
pmc-11622148.description: A case of Short Root Anomaly (SRA), hypodontia and taurodontism with the associated finding of transverse hemimelia, is presented. Although there is no documented evidence of a link between SRA and hemimelia, the shared genetic, environmental and metabolic factors suggest the possibility of a common underlying mechanism.

pmc-12453747.title: Ensemble techniques for detecting profile cloning attacks in online social networks
pmc-12453747.creator: Irfan Mohiuddin, Ahmad Almogren
pmc-12453747.description: Detecting cloned and impersonated profiles on online social networks (OSNs) has become an increasingly critical challenge, particularly with the proliferation of AI-generated content that closely emulates human communication patterns. Traditional identity deception detection methods are proving inadequate against adversaries who exploit large language models (LLMs) to craft syntactically accurate and semantically plausible fake profiles.

pmc-13095595.title: A Newcastle disease outbreak in backyard and free-range poultry in Slovenia
pmc-13095595.creator: Zoran Žlabravec, Brigita Slavec, Alenka Dovč, Aleksandra Hari, Joško Račnik, Jedrt Maurer Wernig, Edoardo Giussani, Elisa Palumbo, Maria Varotto, Isabella Monne, Uroš Krapež
pmc-13095595.description: Newcastle disease (ND) is a highly contagious and economically important viral disease of poultry, caused by virulent strains of Orthoavulavirus javaense (OAVJ). In Slovenia, vaccination is mandatory in commercial poultry and selected avian species, whereas backyard and free-range flock remain largely unregulated.

pmc-13530834.title: Poster 113. Stressors and Achilles Tendon Rupture Risk in American Professional Basketball
pmc-13530834.creator: Nate Kattady, Rohith Ryali, Mani Eftekhari, Matteo L Burnett, Gregory M Waryasz, Eric M Berkson, Soheil Ashkani-Esfahani, Gergo L Merkely
pmc-13530834.description: Objective:Achilles tendon ruptures (ATRs) in American professional basketball have risen markedly and peaked with seven cases during the 2025 season, far higher than the average of 1.3 ATRs per season over the previous three decades. Despite advancements in recovery, ATRs remain career-altering, with one of the lowest return-to-play rates and steepest declines in performance among major orthopedic injuries.

pmc-13594700.title: Multidisciplinary management of rare scrotal hemangioma in adolescents: A case report
pmc-13594700.creator: Farhan Haidar Fazlur Rahman, Indri Aulia, William Makdinata, Fakhri Rahman
pmc-13594700.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Hemangiomas are benign vascular tumors characterized by rapid endothelial cell proliferation. A 16-year-old male presented with scrotal swelling sized 25x25 × 15 cm with arterio-venous malformation in the scrotal region based on the contrast computed tomography angiography examination. Treatment management consisted of embolization carried out by thoracic and vascular surgeon, surgery of the scrotal hemangioma performed by urologist, and the closure of the wound using locoregional flap completed by the plastic surgeon.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general As used in this subchapter: (1) INTELSAT The term “INTELSAT” means the International Telecommunications Satellite Organization established pursuant to the Agreement Relating to the International Telecommunications Satellite Organization (INTELSAT). (2) Inmarsat The term “Inmarsat”.
